item_name: Pink Sabre Pepper Spray USA Formula(kr-nbcf-02)
item_short_desc: The Pink Sabre Pepper Spray offers maximum stopping power in a pocket-sized canister. Legal for sale in 50 States. NY, MA and HI require FFL for purchase.
description: The Pink Sabre Pepper Spray offers maximum stopping power in a pocket-sized canister. Complete with a key ring for hands-free carry, the Sabre Pepper Spray has a ballistic stream which helps reduces wind blow-back. With a range of 8 to 10 feet and containing approximately 25 shots, this is the ideal personal protection item. Sabre donates $0.50 From the sale of every unit to the National Breast Cancer Fund.
